intents.name: order_status
intents.definition: Asks where the order is / what stage it is at / ETA, with no complaint.
intents.boundary_note: A complaint that it is late is delivery_delay.

intents.name: delivery_delay
intents.definition: Complains the order is late or slow, or says the promised time has passed.
intents.boundary_note: Neutral 'where is it / status' is order_status; an explicit 'cancel' is cancel_order.
examples: you are late and the rider isn't picking up my calls

intents.name: cancel_order
intents.definition: Wants the order cancelled (also 'how do I cancel').
intents.boundary_note: Cancel + refund: order not yet delivered = cancel_order; delivered = refund_request.

intents.name: refund_request
intents.definition: Wants money back / asks about a refund or its status.
intents.boundary_note: Refund for a delivered order. 'Charged twice, refund one' sits next to payment_failed - keep with payment_failed.

intents.boundary_note: Problems with a coupon/discount are promo_code_issue; payment page failing at login OTP is account_help.

intents.name: out_of_scope
intents.definition: Anything not about QuickCart orders, accounts or payments: small talk, greetings/thanks alone, gibberish, other companies, services QuickCart does not offer (gift cards, loyalty points, tax invoices, tipping, restaurant feedback).
intents.boundary_note: A greeting plus a real request takes the request's label.

where can I buy a laptop
how do I book a flight
